column1: Hmm, mediocre quality snail. Very tough, make chewy appetizers. You show to Mom, she make buying decisions. Hop Singh just work here.
column2: 嗯，普普通通的蝸牛，很老又韌，只夠做嚼不動的前菜。你拿去給老媽，她做主意，阿星在這裡就是做工的。

column1: Howdy, Hop! How's the restaurant business?
column2: 嘿，阿星！餐館生意怎麼樣啊？

column1: Pretty slow! Not much business. Seem like town closing up and blowing away.
column2: 很差！沒什麼生意。感覺整個鎮好像要關門收攤，隨風飄走了。

column1: You've noticed that too, have you?
column2: 你也注意到了，是吧？

column1: Oh, yes. First Old Abandoned Mine, then Assay Office, then Post Office, then Tall & Thin Shop, then Theatre, yesterday Hotel. What next?
column2: 喔，是啊。先是廢棄舊礦坑，然後驗金所，然後郵局，然後高瘦服飾店，然後劇院，昨天輪到旅館。下一個是什麼？

column1: Well, I intend to get to the bottom of this.
column2: 這件事，我打算查個水落石出。

column1: Maybe hurry, before Mom's next to go! Hop Singh not want to lose his job!
column2: 你最好快點，免得下一個輪到老媽！阿星可不想丟了這份工作！

column1: Can I ask you a question, Hop Singh?
column2: 我可以問你一個問題嗎，阿星？

column1: What's that?
column2: 什麼問題？

column1: It's an inquiry, an interrogative sentence calling for an answer. But that's not important right now. I'd like to know if you've got something against pronouns, contractions and conjunctions. You use so few of them.
column2: 就是一種疑問句，需要你回答的問句。不過這不是重點。我想知道，你是不是對代名詞、縮寫和連接詞有什麼意見？你用得也太少了。

column1: (IN BEAUTIFUL BRITISH ACCENT) I can anytime I like. It's simply that Helen Back paid me handsomely to come and act like an "authentic" Chinese chef. Granted nobody actually speaks like this, but she seems to THINK people speak like this. So, hey, she cuts the checks, I just play along. (CHINESE AGAIN:) That answer question?
column2: （一口標準英倫腔）我想講的時候隨時都能講標準的。只是老媽花大錢請我來扮演一個「道地」的中國廚子。老實說，沒有人真的這樣講話，但她就是認為中國人講話該是這個調調。嘿，反正她付錢，我就配合演一下。（切回洋涇濱腔調：）阿星這樣回答，可以嗎？

column1: Perfectly. Thanks!
column2: 完美，謝了！

column1: Freddy Pharkas again! What with you? I have restaurant to run, you still have Pharmacy to run, yes?
column2: 又是佛萊迪·法卡斯！你又怎麼了？阿星有餐館要顧，你不是也有藥局要顧嗎？

column1: Er... yes.
column2: 呃……是啊。

column1: Then get back to it! I busy here!
column2: 那就回去顧你的！阿星這裡忙著呢！

column1: Hop Singh, you're not mad at me, are you?
column2: 阿星，你該不會在生我的氣吧？

column1: |c0|OUT! OUT! OUT!|c| Hop Singh not want you slinging the bull in here no more.
column2: |c0|滾！滾！滾出去！|c|阿星不想再聽你在這裡胡扯瞎掰了。

column1: But it was an accident! It slipped, okay?
column2: 可是那是意外！它自己滑掉的，好嗎？

column1: Slip? Slip? What you carrying that plop around for in first place? How stupid can one pharmacist get? Honestly!
column2: 滑掉？滑掉？你一開始幹嘛帶著那坨東西到處跑？一個藥師能笨到什麼地步？真是服了！

column1: Uh-oh, he's been hanging around Mom too long!
column2: 糟了，他跟老媽混太久，講話都學她了！

column1: Say, Hop! Hear about the big fire last night?
column2: 欸，阿星！聽說昨晚那場大火了嗎？

column1: Oh yes! Very dramatic.
column2: 喔，聽說了！超戲劇性的。

column1: I came to the rescue, though. Put out the fire single-handedly!
column2: 不過是我出手相救的。我一個人就把火撲滅了！

column1: Ohhh, very good. We all proud of you. You BMOC!
column2: 喔喔，真厲害。大家都以你為榮。你現在是BMOC了！

column1: BMOC?
column2: BMOC是啥？

column1: Big Mensch Of Coarsegold!
column2: 粗金鎮第一大好人的意思啦！

column1: Hop Singh, I'll be leaving town for a while.
column2: 阿星，我要離開小鎮一陣子。

column1: Okay! Hate long goodbyes! Sayonara!
column2: 好啊！阿星最討厭拖拖拉拉的道別！莎唷娜拉！

column1: I'll miss you, too.
column2: 我也會想你的。

column1: Sayonara!
column2: 莎唷娜拉！

column1: You've been just like a chef to me.
column2: 你對我來說，就像個廚師一樣。

column1: SAYONARA! Arrivederci! Adios! Hasta la vista!
column2: 莎唷娜拉！再會啦！阿迪歐斯！下次見啦！

column1: Gee, I don't know much Chinese, Hop, so I don't know what you just said, but... goodbye.
column2: 天啊，我沒學過什麼中文，阿星，所以不知道你剛才講了什麼，不過……再見啦。

column1: GOODBYE!
column2: 再見！

column1: Hey, Hop Singh! Don't serve any water 'til I've had a chance to check it out. I think something's up with the water supply.
column2: 欸，阿星！先別供應任何水，等我檢查過再說。我覺得水源可能出了問題。

column1: No problemo! This California. We not serve water with meals unless customer beg.
column2: 沒問題！這裡是加州。除非客人求我們，不然本來就不會附水。

column1: Hop Singh, I just want to warn you NOT to go outside and NOT to let your customers go outside 'til we've cleared the air.
column2: 阿星，我只是想提醒你，絕對別出門，也別讓客人出門，等我們把空氣清乾淨再說。

column1: We having big argument or something?
column2: 我們是在吵什麼大架嗎？

column1: No, not that I know of.
column2: 沒有啊，我不知道有這回事。

column1: Then why need to clear the air?
column2: 那幹嘛要「把空氣弄乾淨」？

column1: Never mind. Go outside all you like.
column2: 算了，你想出去就出去吧。

column1: Thank you for kind permission!
column2: 多謝你大發慈悲的許可！

column1: Hey, Hop Singh, you know anything about getting people off of anthills?
column2: 欸，阿星，你知不知道怎麼把人從蟻丘上弄下來？

column1: Not hardly!
column2: 完全不知道！

column1: Thanks, you're a big help.
column2: 謝了，你真是幫了大忙。

column1: You not talk to me like that. I got big cleaver.
column2: 你不准這樣跟我說話，阿星可是有把大菜刀的。

column1: Have you heard, Hop Singh? Thar's a stampede a-comin'!
column2: 阿星，你聽說了沒？牛群暴衝要來啦！

column1: Nobody tell Hop Singh nothing back here. Hop Singh could fall over and die and rot and nobody would even know for days.
column2: 在這後面沒人跟阿星說半句話。阿星就算倒地死掉爛掉，大概也沒人會發現，搞不好好幾天都沒人知道。

column1: Well, I'm telling you now.
column2: 好啦，我現在不就在跟你說了。

column1: Ye, yeh. Go and leave Hop Singh to suffer in silence. So what if everybody ignore me? So what if nobody talk to me back here, except Mom when she want something? So what if Hop Singh slave over hot steam table all day and work fingers to the bone?
column2: 是啦，是啦。你就走吧，留阿星一個人默默受苦。大家都不理我又怎樣？這後面除了老媽要使喚我以外，沒人跟阿星講話又怎樣？阿星整天在滾燙的保溫台前累得跟牛一樣，做到十指都要斷掉又怎樣？

column1: I thought you were going to suffer in silence.
column2: 我還以為你要默默受苦呢。

column1: OK for you, Freddy Pharkas! You get yours, you see! You just like all the rest! Vamoose!
column2: 好啊，你狠，佛萊迪·法卡斯！你等著瞧，總有一天會有報應！你跟其他人沒兩樣！滾開！

column1: That brand of beans we use! Some coincidence!
column2: 那正好是我們用的那個牌子的豆子！真巧啊！

column1: I got this can here. Mom gave it to me.
column2: 我這裡有個空罐子，是老媽給我的。

column1: Oh! Impressed. Mom not give old empty tin can to just anyone. Must really like you!
column2: 喔！真讓人佩服。老媽可不是隨便什麼人都給空罐子的。她一定很喜歡你！

column1: Hop Singh not beer-drinker!
column2: 阿星才不喝啤酒！

column1: This is water, not beer.
column2: 這是水，不是啤酒。

column1: Oh-ho, you very sneaky, try to get Hop Singh drunk and give away cooking secrets.
column2: 喔∼你很奸詐喔，想灌醉阿星，套出烹飪秘方。

column1: That's truly not what I had in mind.
column2: 我真的沒那個意思。

column1: Do you no good! Hop Singh not HAVE any cooking secrets! Play it by ear! Guess that twice the work for you, eh? Heh!
column2: 對你一點用都沒有！阿星根本沒有什麼烹飪秘方！全靠隨機應變！看來你要多費一倍工夫囉？嘿嘿！

column1: Very clever! Hop Singh hope you get big points for that.
column2: 很聰明嘛！阿星希望你這招能拿到不少分數。

column1: A-yep!
column2: 啊，對啊！

column1: Good, good! You be hero yet!
column2: 很好，很好！你這樣下去，遲早會變英雄的！

column1: Hop Singh have no need of empty glass.
column2: 阿星用不著空杯子。

column1: You can't reach anything in the kitchen from here.
column2: 你在這裡搆不到廚房裡的任何東西。

column1: Mom's kitchen is spotlessly clean and efficiently-run.
column2: 老媽的廚房一塵不染，運作得有條有理。

column1: The kitchen counter. (Let's see... you count 1 kitchen!)
column2: 廚房流理台。（讓我數數看……你數到1個廚房！）

column1: There's nothing on the counter you need.
column2: 流理台上沒有你需要的東西。

column1: Hopalong Singh (Hop, for short) doesn't take kindly to people invading his inner sanctum.
column2: 「霍帕龍·星」（大家都簡稱阿星）可不喜歡有人闖進他的私人聖地。

column1: Nobody goes into my kitchen without my permission. |c0|Nobody,|c| do you hear?
column2: 沒有我的允許，誰都不准進我的廚房。|c0|誰都不准，|c|聽到了嗎？

column1: Heed her warning. The last customer who crossed Mom ended up on the Blue Plate Special.
column2: 最好聽她的警告。上一個惹毛老媽的客人，最後成了「今日特餐」。

column1: These swingin' kitchen doors do nothing to keep the smells in the kitchen.
column2: 這幾扇廚房彈簧門，完全擋不住味道飄出來。

column1: You poke her in the shoulder pad. Ewww! It's all mushy and bloated! Charlotte doesn't even glance at you. She's too busy talking with her mouth full.
column2: 你戳了戳她的墊肩。噁！軟軟爛爛、鼓鼓脹脹的！夏洛特連看都沒看你一眼，她正忙著滿嘴食物講八卦呢。

column1: Yes, it's SOOOO tempting! But you'll have to restrain your murderous impulses. It's just not in character.
column2: 是啊，真的超級誘人！不過你還是得壓抑住殺意，這不符合你的人設。

column1: She's too intent on getting her just desserts to care about that.
column2: 她一心只顧著吃她的甜點，才沒空理你這個。

column1: Charlotte Russe, one of the local gossips, is stuffing her face with dessert, a sponge cake and whipped cream monstrosity. It makes your arteries seize up just looking at her!
column2: 夏洛特·露絲，鎮上的長舌婦之一，正大口塞著甜點——一坨海綿蛋糕加鮮奶油的恐怖巨物。光看著她吃，你都覺得自己的血管要塞住了！

column1: Hello, Mrs. Russe. That sure is a lovely dessert you're wearing today!
column2: 你好啊，露絲太太。你今天「穿」的這道甜點還真是漂亮呢！

column1: (GARBLED) Mmph gluphum truph aphuphuphum.
column2: （含糊不清）嗯呣咕嚕嚕呣咕嚕呣。

column1: You poke Sarah in the back, but she doesn't stop talking for a moment. What concentration! What dedication! What a MOUTH!
column2: 你戳了戳莎拉的背，但她講話一刻也沒停。真是專心！真是敬業！真是一張大嘴巴！

column1: That would be justice, wouldn't it? Sarah's stabbed so many people in the back, it would only be fair for someone to turn the tables. But a first-degree murder charge might interfere with your efforts to save the town just now.
column2: 這樣也算是一種正義吧？莎拉在背後捅了那麼多人一刀，也該有人反過來對付她一下才公平。不過，一項一級謀殺罪名，恐怕會妨礙你現在拯救小鎮的大業。

column1: She's far too busy cutting down people she hardly knows to bother with the likes of you. Maybe you should offer her a saucer of milk!
column2: 她正忙著數落一堆她根本不熟的人，沒空理你這種角色。也許你該端一碟牛奶給她——就當她是隻貓吧！

column1: It's Sarah Hardtbern, the director of the local community theatre. She's doing some power-klatsching... massacring several cheese danish, numerous cups of cappucino, and three or four reputations.
column2: 這位是莎拉·哈特伯恩，鎮上社區劇院的導演。她正在大搞「八卦茶會」……一口氣幹掉了好幾塊起司丹麥酥、無數杯卡布奇諾，還有三四個人的名譽。

column1: Howdy, Sarah. Any big productions planned this season?
column2: 哈囉，莎拉。這一季有什麼大戲要上演嗎？

column1: She ignores you. Apparently she doesn't like to be interrupted in mid-slander.
column2: 她不理你。看樣子她討厭別人在她講八卦講到一半時打斷她。

column1: No need to, since it's always bright, sunny and cheerful in Mom's Cafe. Mostly because the weather wouldn't DARE cross Mom!
column2: 沒必要，因為老媽餐館裡永遠是晴朗、開朗又愉快。大概是天氣也不敢惹老媽吧！

column1: A decorative oil lamp is attached to the wooden support beam.
column2: 一盞裝飾用的油燈掛在木製的支撐橫梁上。

column1: This is no time to sit and chow down. You've got work to do!
column2: 現在不是坐下來大吃大喝的時候，你還有正事要辦！

column1: Homey, red-and-white-striped spotless-tablecloths cover Mom's tables.
column2: 老媽的桌子上鋪著溫馨的紅白條紋桌布，乾淨得一塵不染。

column1: Better not let Mom catch you fooling around with her order wheel!
column2: 最好別讓老媽逮到你在亂動她的點餐輪盤！

column1: Do you have an order to put on the order wheel?
column2: 你有點餐單要放上點餐輪盤嗎？

column1: Then were you going to take one of the orders and fill it?
column2: 那你是打算拿一張訂單去出餐嗎？

column1: Er... no.
column2: 呃……不是。

column1: Then keep your hands by your sides before I make them a permanent fixture.
column2: 那就把手放好，不然我讓你的手永遠固定在這裡。

column1: It's an order wheel.
column2: 這是點餐輪盤。

column1: No, thank you, Frederick. I don't drink, and I hope you don't, either. After all, lips that touch liquor will never touch mine!
column2: 不用了，謝謝你，佛萊迪。我不喝酒，也希望你別喝。畢竟，沾過酒的嘴唇，絕不會碰到我的嘴唇！

column1: Hey, I hear ya, Penelope! Lips that lick... yes, what you just said.
column2: 嘿，我懂你的意思，潘妮洛普！沾過的嘴唇……對，就是你剛說的那樣。

column1: Hmmm, a pair of cowboy boots. The kind that ruffians and hooligans wear. Wherever did you find these?
column2: 嗯，一雙牛仔靴，那種流氓惡棍才會穿的款式。你是從哪裡弄來的？

column1: They were my... I just... they... um, I forget. Yes, that's it, I forget.
column2: 這是我的……我只是……那個……嗯，我忘了。對，就是這樣，我忘記了。

column1: Hm. Well, I'd get rid of them immediately before somebody gets the idea that you're some sort of gunslinger!
column2: 嗯，那你最好馬上處理掉，免得有人誤以為你是什麼槍手。

column1: No. I mean yes.
column2: 不是。我是說，對。

column1: Thank you, Frederick. I like looking at you, too.
column2: 謝謝你，佛萊迪。我也喜歡看著你。

column1: Penelope, look! I've concocted something that will cure the horses of their noxious fume-emitting!
column2: 潘妮洛普，你看！我調配出一種東西，可以治好馬匹排放臭氣的毛病！

column1: Tres magnifique, Frederick!!
column2: Tres magnifique，佛萊迪！！

column1: No, it's nothing like that. I call it "Deflatulizer."
column2: 不，不是那樣，我把它叫做「除脹氣機」。

column1: Oh, I see. Well, I'm very proud of you nonetheless.
column2: 喔，原來如此。不管怎樣，我還是以你為榮。

column1: Frederick, please! Not in front of Mom.
column2: 佛萊迪，拜託！別在老媽面前提這個。

column1: Look, Penelope!
column2: 你看，潘妮洛普！

column1: Isn't that the key to your Pharmacy, Frederick?
column2: 佛萊迪，那不是你藥局的鑰匙嗎？

column1: Yes, Penelope! Very good, ten points!
column2: 沒錯，潘妮洛普！答對了，加十分！

column1: But you shouldn't be waving it around, Frederick! You wouldn't want anyone to steal it and rob the Pharmacy, would you?
column2: 可是你不該這樣揮來揮去的，佛萊迪！你總不想有人偷走它，跑去洗劫藥局吧？

column1: You chuckle confidently as you slip the key back into your pocket.
column2: 你自信滿滿地笑了笑，把鑰匙塞回口袋。

column1: What a... |c2|thoughtful|c|... gift, Frederick. Tell you what: why don't YOU hang onto these for me, since I don't want to. Thank you so much.
column2: 真是……|c2|貼心|c|……的禮物啊，佛萊迪。這樣吧，既然我不想要，不如你自己留著保管，好嗎？太感謝了。

column1: Sure. A-yuh. A-yuh.
column2: 當然。啊，好。啊，好。

column1: Want to look in this bag, Penelope? G'wan, I dare you.
column2: 要不要看看這個袋子裡有什麼，潘妮洛普？來嘛，我賭你不敢。

column1: Why, certainly, Frederick. I'll be happy to open this bag and look inside, if that's what you'd like me to do. Bear in mind, though, that I don't really like surprises very much. Let's both hope there's nothing in this bag that would make me cross with you. Shall I open it now?
column2: 哎呀，當然好啊，佛萊迪。如果這是你希望的，我很樂意打開這個袋子看看裡面。不過先說好，我其實不太喜歡驚喜。我們就一起祈禱，這袋子裡沒有會讓我對你生氣的東西吧。我現在就打開，好嗎？

column1: No, no, no, no, no. No. I just wanted to see if you wanted to. Don't open it.
column2: 不不不不不，不用了。我只是想看看你敢不敢答應而已，別打開它。

column1: Very well.
column2: 那好吧。

column1: No thank you, Frederick. My, I haven't purposefully hyperventilated since my college days!
column2: 不用了，謝謝你，佛萊迪。天啊，自從大學時期以後，我就沒故意過度換氣了！

column1: Look at this new invention of mine, Penelope. It filters noxious odors out of the air by forcing air to pass through a chamber filled with activated charcoal.
column2: 看看我這項新發明，潘妮洛普。它讓空氣通過一個裝滿活性碳的腔室，藉此過濾掉空氣中的臭氣。

column1: That's exceedingly clever, Frederick! If you provide one of these to every man, woman and child in the town, we'll be safe from the poisonous fumes being emitted by the horses!
column2: 真是聰明極了，佛萊迪！如果你能讓鎮上每個男女老少都有一個，我們就能免於馬匹排放的毒氣威脅了！

column1: Oh... well, I only made this one. This is all the charcoal there was.
column2: 呃……這個嘛，我只做了這一個。這是我僅有的活性碳了。

column1: Ah, well then. Use it wisely, Frederick. Our safety is in your hands, my handsome pharmacist!
column2: 啊，那好吧。要善加利用它，佛萊迪。我們的安全就掌握在你手裡了，我英俊的藥師！

column1: That certainly looks sharp and pointy, Frederick! Please, take it away before I puncture myself!
column2: 那看起來真是又尖又利，佛萊迪！拜託快拿走，免得我把自己刺傷！

column1: I certainly hope that's not the ladder from our playground slide, Frederick. I'd hate to think you'd stolen that from the children. I would have to rethink our whole relationship.
column2: 我真希望那不是我們遊樂場溜滑梯的梯子，佛萊迪。要是想到你從孩子們那裡偷走的，我可不好受，那我就得重新考慮我們的關係了。

column1: No, it just looks like the playground slide. I wouldn't steal anything from children. (Gulp!)
column2: 不是啦，那只是長得像遊樂場的溜滑梯而已。我才不會偷孩子的東西呢。（倒抽一口氣！）

column1: Whatever for, Frederick? It's addressed to you. Why would I want it?
column2: 這是要幹嘛，佛萊迪？這是寄給你的，我要它做什麼？

column1: That's good, let's keep it that way, shall we?
column2: 很好，那就保持這樣吧，好嗎？

column1: It's Penelope! Just look at the way she sits at that table and eats and talks! Isn't she simply dreamy?
column2: 是潘妮洛普！你看她坐在那張桌子邊，又吃又聊天的樣子！她是不是美得像夢一樣？

column1: MY SWEETHEART!
column2: 我的心上人！

column1: You don't owe me any money, Frederick. You keep it, I insist.
column2: 你不欠我錢，佛萊迪。你留著吧，我堅持。

column1: Yes, I was just showing it to you.
column2: 對，我只是拿給你看看而已。

column1: Oh. I knew that. No, I don't drink beer, that's why I was offering it to you.
column2: 喔，我知道啊。不，我不喝啤酒，所以才拿來請你喝。

column1: Penelope, be careful. For some reason, the horses in town are expelling huge quantities of poison gas! It's not safe outside.
column2: 潘妮洛普，小心點。不知道為什麼，鎮上的馬匹正排放大量毒氣！外面不安全。

column1: My hero! I'll stay inside until it's safe. Thank you, Freddy. You may have just saved my life. I suppose I'll have to find a way to repay your kindness... if that's all right with you.
column2: 我的英雄！我會待在裡面，等安全了再說。謝謝你，佛萊迪。你搞不好剛剛救了我一命。我想我得找個方法報答你的好意……如果你不介意的話。

column1: Why, sure! I mean... wow, hot dog, Penelope! I mean, er... sounds good!
column2: 這個嘛，當然好啊！我是說……哇，太棒了，潘妮洛普！我是說，呃……聽起來不錯！

column1: You can't reach that hot apple pie from here!
column2: 你在這裡搆不到那個熱蘋果派！

column1: How tempting! Fresh apple pie, still warm from Mom's oven. What could be more American?
column2: 真誘人！剛出爐的新鮮蘋果派，還帶著老媽烤箱的餘溫。還有什麼比這更美式的呢？

column1: Where were you going to go with it? To the "post" office?
column2: 你打算拿著它去哪？去「郵」局嗎？

column2: 這根支撐柱已經撐起老媽餐館好多年了。

column1: You consider doing your Famous Tablecloth Trick, but there's nobody around to be impressed!
column2: 你考慮要不要表演你那招知名的「抽桌布戲法」，可是這裡根本沒人可以驚艷！

column1: Anybody wanna see my Spectacular Tablecloth Trick?
column2: 有沒有人想看我的「壯觀抽桌布戲法」啊？

column1: Anybody want to see my famous "Julienne A Troublemaker and Serve Him As A Side Order with the Chicken-Fried Steak" trick?
column2: 有沒有人想看我知名的「把找碴的傢伙切成細絲，配炸雞排一起上桌」戲法？

column2: 仔細想想，抽桌布戲法好像也沒那麼壯觀，還是算了吧。

column1: Smart boy.
column2: 算你聰明。

column1: If you get your fingerprints on anything in this spotlessly clean, cozy little cafe, Mom will check out the fingerprints, trace them to you, and make you one sorry hombre.
column2: 要是你在這間一塵不染、溫馨小巧的餐館裡留下指紋，老媽會查出指紋、追到你頭上，讓你悔不當初。

column1: Get your greasy fingerprints on anything and I'll staple your fingers over them.
column2: 敢在任何東西上留下油膩的指紋，我就把你的手指釘在上面。

column1: It's Mom's Cafe, owned by Helen Back, "The Surliest Mom In The West."
column2: 這是老媽餐館，老闆是海倫·貝克，人稱「西部最兇老媽」。

column1: That's there to be admired, not conversed with.

column1: Certainly, yes, I understand.
column2: 當然，是的，我懂。

column1: That's good. See how nice things are when we cooperate with each other?
column2: 很好。你看，我們互相配合的時候，一切多美好啊？

column2: 有，我想我有點過。

column2: 那我相信，你的「腸」覺會告訴你答案。

column1: Ulp!
column2: 嗚啊！

column2: 這主意以後再說也許不錯，但現在，那可不是你能亂戳的罐子！
